title: release-policy.json
description: Fixed release cadence of every release-please unit in a repository, where each stage ships to, and which product the repository belongs to. Explained in docs/release-policy.md.

allOf.description: A member repository (product.primary) lists its units.
A restricted repository names the npm scope its packages publish under.
So does one with any restricted unit. A hub has no units, so only its own access can ask for a scope.

product.description: The product whose version sequence this repository shares. The primary repository holds the Release Plans under releases/ and lists the members: the product repository itself for a single-repository product, <product>-hub for one spread over several repositories. A member repository names the primary.

members.description: Member repositories as owner/repo. Empty when the product lives in this repository alone.

access.description: Whether what this repository publishes is a non-public package once published: public, or restricted. It says nothing about whether the repository is public, where it publishes, or private: true. A unit's own access overrides it. A hub writes it too.

scope.description: npm scope of the restricted packages, e.g. "@carlos-space". Required when this repository or any unit is restricted.

targets.description: Destination of each stage shared by the service, backend and web units of this repository, e.g. an environment name.

units.description: Every unit of release-please-config.json, keyed by its component. A unit missing here, or listed here but not there, fails the daily consistency check. Required in a member repository; a <product>-hub has no units and leaves it out.

kind.description: Release type of the unit. package and sdk publish every stage to their registry; mobile and desktop ship to store channels; service, backend and web deploy to environments.

access.description: Overrides the repository access for this unit. A unit that does not publish fills in what it would be if it did.

stages.description: Stages the unit walks when it releases on its own, in order and ending at ga. A unit depended on by a unit in a prerelease, and changed in this release, follows that unit's stages instead.

targets.description: Destination of each stage for this unit, overriding the repository targets. Store channels for mobile and desktop.

dependsOn.description: Same-repository units this unit depends on that its package manifest cannot express, e.g. a binding across languages.
